def execute():
    import math
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    p = list(map(float, input().split()))
    results = []
    for i in range(n):
        if abs(p[i]) < 1e-6:
            results.append("0")
            continue
        size = n - 1
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << size)
        others = [p[j] for j in range(n) if j != i]
        dp[0] = p[i]
        sum_result = dp[0]
        for mask in range(1, 1 << size):
            sumP = 0.0
            sumVal = 0.0
            cnt = 0
            for t in range(size):
                if mask & (1 << t):
                    sumP += others[t]
                    sumVal += others[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)]
                    cnt += 1
            dp[mask] = sumVal / (1 - sumP)
            if cnt < k:
                sum_result += dp[mask]
        results.append(str(sum_result))
    print(" ".join(results))
